items.title: Crimson Desert attacks Charting the Unknown DLC's major issues as dozens of problems get fixed
items.summary: Charting the Unknown has been fixed 🙌
items.content:
There's a lot to unpack with Crimson Desert's latest patch update.

Crimson Desert’s latest DLC expansion, Charting the Unknown, has been hit with a multitude of fixes to address player concerns and frustrations.

The Game of the Year contender got even better when Charting the Unknown’s map and gameplay expansion dropped as a free update, mind you.

However, as is the case with open-world games, all of that space and all of those gameplay mechanics can lead to some less-than- ideal bugs, glitches or general oversights. Hopefully that won’t be the case for Grand Theft Auto VI ; otherwise, we may have another Cyberpunk 2077 disaster on our hands…

Back to Crimson Desert , though. Pearl Abyss has released Update 2.05.00 and so far players are very pleased with what’s been added and changed.

You can find the full patch notes on the official Crimson Desert website , but you can find the main changes below.

One of the biggest additions is making Charting the Unknown playable on Apple Mac devices, along with various fixes.

Much of the update revolves around balancing for the DLC, though, but unfortunately this doesn’t include making the new ships any cheaper… They still cost a fortune…

One note reads: "Reduced the number of hostile creatures in the Central Waters, Great Coral Reef, and Great Rocky Reef” which is a change all players can get behind, as the previous number of enemies made exploration a pain.

Other changes included the “location of Arimuzar Village” and improvements to some of the boss battles. The notes say “selecting ‘Retry’ now starts from the last combat phase reached.” That’s a solid change, as the boss fights in Crimson Desert aren’t its strong suit.

As I was reading through the notes, this one also stood out to me, but more so because it was funny than a game-changer. It read: “Fixed an issue where a spouse following the player would pass out after falling into the water.”

Altogether, there are dozens, and dozens of fixes and once again players are applauding Pearl Abyss for its continued support.

While Crimson Desert might struggle to secure the Game of the Year award (if it’s even nominated) due to the likes of GTA VI and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (2026) competing too, it should at least get a crack at Best Ongoing Game or Best Role-Playing Game.

In case you missed it, Pearl Abyss is giving PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S players the chance to try the game for free .

items.title: This Cyberpunk 2077 graphics overhaul has managed to get me hyped for Project Orion
items.summary: It's going to be many, many years before the sequel arrives though 😅
items.content:
Project Orion is years away, but mods like this remind me of just how excited I am.

Project Orion , a sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 , is in development, but it’s a game that I try not to think about too often.

That’s largely due to the fact that its arrival is a long way off, and I’m trying to save myself some of the impatience I’ve experienced with the likes of Grand Theft Auto VI and The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel.

CD Projekt RED is hard at work developing The Witcher IV , which is due out in 2028. Project Orion is not set to become the studio’s main focus until following The Witcher IV ’s launch.

Given the fact that developers won’t want to rush Project Orion and repeat Cyberpunk 2077 ’s mistakes, it places the game as potentially arriving in the mid 2030s.

You’re perhaps seeing my logic now for almost pretending the project doesn’t exist, but it was recently brought to the forefront of my attention thanks to an awesome new mod.

‘ Atmos 2077 ’ is an incredible new graphical overhaul mod for Cyberpunk 2077 with results so impressive that I immediately started pondering what Project Orion might look like.

Created by NexusMods user robindubronx, ‘Atmos 2077’ is a very comprehensive offering, introducing new volumetric clouds to Cyberpunk 2077 , as well as new rain and thunderstorm effects, including dynamic raindrops on your car’s windshield.

You should also expect rainbows, ballistic missile trails in the sky, and more. As you’ve likely gathered, it’s a weather-based mod, but one that hugely boosts the immersive experience of navigating Night City.

That’s no easy feat to pull off because Night City is arguably one of gaming’s most immersive open worlds anyway, but ‘Atmos 2077’ just manages to refine what it offers perfectly.

“Night City runs on neon, chrome, and rain. In the vanilla game, the rain is a flat curtain of streaks under a painted sky,” begins the mod’s creator.

“Atmos 2077 rewires the whole atmosphere: volumetric clouds you can read like a weather map, real rain that lands, glass that holds water, storms that light up from inside, and rainbows when the sun cuts back through.”

Everything within the mod is drawn inside the game’s own renderer via REDgraph, so no ReShade or overlay was used.

The mod’s storms are incredibly cozy, if that’s not a weird thing to say. There’s something quite mesmerising about driving Night City’s streets amid a biblical storm.

items.title: 10 Best Open World Games with Character Creation, Ranked
items.summary: Open-world games like Elden Ring and Cyberpunk 2077 are better because of their character creators.
items.content:
Image via FromSoftware Add CBR on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover By Mandi Odoerfer Published Nov 12, 2026, 10:15 PM EST Mandi has been writing about comics and video games for more than ten years and has been reading and playing them her entire life. Her writing has been featured at TapTap , GameZone , US Gamer, and many other sites. She joined CBR in 2024, where she works as a writer and editor, covering video games and comic books. In her downtime, she occasionally muses about anime, RPGs, and the best Steam demos on her Substack, Cartoon Ghost , though she often finds herself retreating to the comfort of her favorite games. Mandi is currently replaying the entire Pokémon series, starting with Red & Blue . Sign in to your CBR account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Open-world games don't always let players create their own characters, but many of the best games in the genre have in-depth character creation tools. Games like Elden Ring and Cyberpunk 2077 let players make a character of their choosing, with in-depth tools that can bring all kinds of concepts to life.

Not only do many open-world games with character creators give players extreme control over their character's appearance, but many allow them to customize their characters in other ways as well, such as determining their background and assigning them with specific skills. When done well, character creation can feel like its own game.

Not many games offer the level of player agency that Mount and Blade II: Bannerlord does. It's a mixture of genres, blending tactical gameplay with first and third-person real-time combat, along with RPG elements and settlement creation. Even the main narrative can be ignored with minimal consequences.

On top of that, players can customize their character's appearance, choose their civilization of origin, and answer a series of questions to build a background that influences their skills. After that, players are free to pursue their own path, whether as a merchant, a trusted general commanding a large army, or a leader of a smaller mercenary band working for the highest bidder.

Rip Mystery Packs of Graded Cards & Collectibles

Japanese Pokémon Center 20th Anniversary Promo · PSA 10

Must be 18+/19+ to participate depending on jurisdiction.

code vein 2 ichor jail Image via Bandai Namco While it can be fun to create a character from scratch, many of the best video game character creators also let players recreate their favorite characters from other properties. Few games are as good at this as Code Vein and its open-world sequel, Code Vein II , which give players the tools to make almost any anime character.

Many of the most popular anime characters of all time have been recreated in Code Vein II , including Gojo Satoru from Jujutsu Kaisen and Mikasa Ackerman from Attack on Titan . It's a game that no anime fan who loves character creators should miss.

Sign in to claim your place on the leaderboard!

Image via FromSoftware Elden Ring has become a legendary title in the years since its release, and only a few games in the genre can surpass it . While FromSoftware's games have always been known for the amount of freedom they allow players, Elden Ring is the most open by far, with an open world that's fascinating to explore.

There's excellent character customization in Elden Ring , but while players can choose their protagonist's gender, age, class, keepsakes, and physical appearance, the most exciting aspect is the freedom players have over character builds. There are 10 starting classes in Elden Ring , and choosing the right build can make the game far more approachable.

Image via Bethesda While Fallout 4 has been criticized for its story, it offers the most expansive and free open world in the franchise. The Green Jewel of the Commonwealth, Diamond City, doesn't quite measure up to iconic locations like New Vegas, Rivet City, or Megaton, but in this game, it doesn't matter. Players can create a settlement from scratch and make it their own.

Character customization is crucial in video games, and games like Baldur's Gate III, Fallout 4, and Starfield have many more options than others.

items.title: Nintendo Black Friday Sale Confirms $20 Discount for Switch 2 Games Like Donkey Kong Bananza
items.summary: Nintendo has confirmed several Switch 2 exclusive games will be discounted during its upcoming, including $20 off Donkey Kong Bananza.
items.content:
Nintendo has finally confirmed details for its 2026 Black Friday sale . Not only does it include a much-awaited $50 discount on Switch 2 consoles (effectively wiping out the September price hike), but it will also feature $20 off several Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 games.

Nintendo has confirmed a handful of games that will be included in the sale so far, but we'll have to wait to see the full list of offers when the sale kicks off on November 22.

So far, games confirmed to be included in the sale are Donkey Kong Bananza, Kirby AirRiders, and Metroid Prime 4: Beyond for Switch 2, alongside Super Mario Galaxy 1+2 and Super Mario Party Jamboree for the original Switch.

Nintendo has stated that the aforementioned games will be available from $39.99 each, with a standard $20 discount applied across the board on the Switch exclusive games.

Not to confuse fans, but "starting at $39.99 each" may have some fans thinking that Donkey Kong Bananza will be down to $39.99, but since its MSRP is still $69.99 in the US, we're expecting its price to be $49.99. That should also apply for Kirby AirRiders and Metroid Prime 4: Beyond.

Nintendo has also confirmed that Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Target, GameStop, and the official Nintendo Store will carry these offers during the Black Friday sales at each respective retailer.

It's not necessary to wait for what I like to call Black Friday proper if you only after the games in the official Nintendo sale. While most retailers spend November teasing limited-time offers, but the reality is that the deepest discounts rarely arrive until about a week before the big day.

Nintendo is following this trend with the deals starting on November 22, five days before the official sale day that no retailer ever sticks to these days. But., having tracked Nintendo sales for years, one thing is clear: once a Switch deal hits, it usually sticks for the rest of the sale.

That means the prices you see on consoles, games, and accessories are very likely the ones that’ll hold through to the end of November, and while not yet confirmed, likely December as well. If you’ve been holding out for a solid deal, there will be no need to wait any longer once the sale starts.

These offers are reliable and worthwhile. But, you should still keep an eye out for more deals on other third-party games in the coming days as well, alongside plenty more from the Nintendo exclusive catalog.

Sony and Microsoft Confirm GTA 6 Has Broken Their Digital Store Preorder Records
items.summary: Sensor Tower estimates 9.69 million digital console preorders for GTA 6, above Cyberpunk 2077's official 8 million across all formats.
items.content:
By Ray Ampoloquio · Nov 10, 2026 Add GTA BOOM on Google Pick your GTA topics Get a feed of news & guides Sensor Tower estimates 9.69 million digital console preorders for GTA 6 , above Cyberpunk 2077 's official 8 million across all formats.

Zoom image: GTA 6 has an estimated 9.69 million digital pre-orders, says Sensor Tower. If only we had a dime for every time it's been said that Grand Theft Auto VI has not launched and yet is already breaking records . According to the sales tracker Sensor Tower, the game is now the most pre-ordered title in history, with an estimated 9.69 million digital pre-orders across PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. The total has pushed it past Cyberpunk 2077 , the game that held the previous mark.

The numbers are staggering for a pre-launch window. Sensor Tower puts the revenue from those pre-orders at around $942 million, net of returns and cancellations and all of it comes from just two console platforms with nine days still on the clock. GTA VI has no PC version at launch , so this record is built entirely on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series owners.

The fine print matters here though. Sensor Tower's figure is a third-party estimate of digital console pre-orders only, so it leaves out physical copies and any PC sales. Cyberpunk 2077 's 8 million was an official CD Projekt Red disclosure that counted both digital and physical across more platforms, PC included.

However, this is not only tracker noise. Sony and Microsoft have each confirmed GTA VI as the most pre-ordered title in the history of their digital stores, the PlayStation Store and the Microsoft Store, without putting out exact totals.

Take-Two Interactive has said pre-orders are far exceeding expectations, matching our earlier coverage of pre-orders vastly beating its forecasts , even though it held its full-year forecast steady and has not published a global number.

The two figures are not measured the same way, which is the catch behind the record.

Analyst Daniel Dawkins points out that pre-orders are speeding up as launch nears. We have watched that curve steepen for months, from Xbox pre-orders alone passing a million to a noticeable surge after the premiere of GTA VI: An Extended Look . Sensor Tower had GTA VI at 7.71 million about six days earlier, so it has added roughly 330,000 a day since. If that pace merely holds, Dawkins reckons on X that another 2.97 million could come in before launch, for a total near 12.7 million.

Of course, pre-order-to-sales ratios can swing wildly, from around 20 percent for some games to the 50 to 60 percent Cyberpunk 2077 saw. Sensor Tower's data is not official either. For scale, Grand Theft Auto V sold 29 million copies in its first six weeks and has gone on to move more than 200 million. Against those pre-orders, Dawkins suggests 25 million first-month copies now looks conservative .

With that said, pre-order records are messy by nature, with every tracker, platform and publisher counting the number differently, so the only way we'll know what's true is if Take-Two confirms it at its next earnings call . Until then, we'll have to wait for official confirmation.

Still, if this is indeed true, it shouldn't come as a huge surprise based on how much traction the game has and will continue to get . At this rate, the people who bet on a historic launch may have underestimated the pull of Grand Theft Auto .

Ray Ampoloquio Editor and News Writer , GTA BOOM

Ray is a GTA BOOM editor and news writer covering GTA 6, Rockstar and Take-Two, GTA Online and franchise history using primary-source reporting.

items.title: GTA 6 Might Be The Most Pre-Ordered Game Ever, According to Data
items.summary: Rockstar Games seems to already have a winner in its hands with GTA 6, as the game is apparently the most pre-ordered game ever.
items.content:
It would hardly be a shock, but a reputable data tracker claims that GTA 6 has already become the most pre-ordered game of all time, eclipsing the previous record holder.

We could probably end the story there, as there’s an air of expectancy with GTA 6 . Rockstar’s epic action game is already smashing it, and the game’s not even here. GTA 6 pre-sales are “Far In Excess” of Take-Two’s expectations , which is saying a lot, and a data tracker believes it’s already become the GOAT of pre-order numbers.

Also, you can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here , if you haven’t already!

There are some loose variables here, so bear with us. Firstly, the most pre-ordered game for a long time is claimed to be Cyberpunk 2077. GamesIndustry.biz reported that CD Projekt Red’s much-hyped title ‘racked up 8m pre-orders,’ and many believe this to be the pre-order mark to beat—but not official.

Going on this basis, Sensor Tower ‘s latest sales figures estimate GTA 6 has crossed 9.69M, which easily smashes Cyberpunk 2077’s record if true. Sensor Tower is quite a reliable source for numbers, but as with any data tracker, take any data with a pinch of salt.

The company estimates the split is a bang-on 75/25 split: 7.23 million on PlayStation and 2.46 million on XBOX. The cumulative revenue sits at just under $1 billion at $942 million.

Even if these figures aren’t completely accurate, it feels like common sense that GTA 6 will be the most pre-ordered game of all time when all is said and done. Clearing a billion dollars in pre-sales feels inevitable, especially with most gamers buying the Ultimate Edition, and FOMO is going to kick in hard in the final few days before launch, surely prompting more last-minute pre-orders.

Once the game is out, rereleases and other factors will only keep the money rolling in, and Take-Two’s CEO says a GTA 6 disc release and PC version update would have to come from Rockstar , both of which would drive sales.

items.title: From the Anime to the Game — Free Update Brings Edgerunners 2 Content and More to Cyberpunk 2077!
items.summary: The free Edgerunners 2 Update to Cyberpunk 2077 is available now, with content inspired by the second installment of the hit anime series now streaming on Netflix
items.content:
“Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2” premiered on Netflix on October 20, bringing a whole new cast of characters to Night City for a dark, gritty ride. And now we’re bringing a little piece of that story into Cyberpunk 2077 , too! The free Edgerunners 2 Update is here, with content inspired by the anime, new ways to fight, more customization options, and plenty of other additions.

We’ve got a lot to cover, so let’s get into it. And don’t worry if you haven’t watched the new anime yet — no “Edgerunners 2” spoilers ahead!

One of the things we love about Night City is that there’s always another story unfolding somewhere. V may be central to the events of Cyberpunk 2077 , but they’re hardly the only merc in town, fighting to survive and make a name for themselves on those neon-soaked streets. Every fixer has clients, every crew has gigs to take care of, every Night City merc has their story — and sometimes, those stories collide in unexpected ways.

That’s exactly what happens in the brand-new quest introduced with the “Edgerunners 2” Update. What begins as just another gig from Wakako turns into an action-packed, high-stakes mission that sees V cross paths with Weak Kingsley, a famed Night City merc and one of the main characters of “Edgerunners 2.” We won’t spoil what happens, but during the course of this mission, V has a chance to assist Weak and his crew during a risky gig that takes place in a brand-new location: Night City Prison.

The new “Edgerunners 2” gig is more than a chance to encounter characters from the anime in the game — it serves as a prequel to the events of the series. So, play the quest before watching the anime, and you’ll have a little extra context going into Episode 1. Already seen the show? Then with this gig, you’ll get to revisit part of Weak’s story with a broader perspective of him and his crew.

And there’s even more forEdgerunnersfans in this update. For starters, you can find and equip Weak’s full outfit — vest, glasses, coat, pants, the works — and get your hands on his signature revolver, Coronation. We’ve also added a new radio station, HKGN 102.FM, featuring official tracks from both “Cyberpunk: Edgerunners” and “Edgerunners 2.” So if you’re planning to spend a few more hours cruising around Night City after watching the show, we’ve got your soundtrack covered.

What’s better than blasting your way through a warehouse full of gangoons with a revolver, dealing one headshot after another? Doing it with two revolvers, obviously.

That’s right — dual wielding is here! With the Edgerunners 2 Update, you can raise hell with a pistol or revolver in each hand. That’s a whole new vibe — and a whole new level of awesome.

But dual wielding isn’t just about looking cool. It brings a new playstyle and a fresh way to approach combat — in fact, it’s one of the most significant gameplay additions to the game’s combat since Update 2.0 introduced throwing knives. So if you’ve been looking for an excuse to shake up your fighting style, this might just be it.

Cyberware enhances your stats and abilities — but what if it could take your style to the next level, too? That’s where glamdocs come in. These new vendors let you customize the appearance of your cyberware, with 40 styles in different colors to choose from. Fancy a new look for your chrome? Pay them a visit at one (or all) of the five locations across Night City and see what catches your eye.

In a city that lives and dies by appearances, V really can’t afford to pass up any opportunity to shake up their look. On top of cyberware customization, we’ve also added 20 new hairstyles and several clothing sets to give your V the best chance of standing out, even in Night City.

We know how creative the Cyberpunk 2077 community can be, and we’re always curious to see what players come up with. That’s why we’re introducing cross-platform mod support through mod.io integration.

The update adds a Mods panel where you can browse and install supported community-created content directly in the game. It’s a new way to experiment with your experience, and we’re looking forward to seeing how it develops as more mods become available and receive support over time!

We’ve covered some of the bigger additions, but there’s still plenty to find in the Edgerunners 2 Update.

Thought you were done with Night City? Well, Night City's not quite done with you!

Patch notes for Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) are now available for your early perusal before the update hits the streets on October 22nd. Watch the Features Overview video to see some of the new features in action:

And if you want to know even more, read through the list of most important changes below:

Edgerunners Content

  • Added a new side quest, Clampdown, set before the events of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. To unlock it, complete The Heist and two gigs for Wakako, then wait for a message from her.

    [/*]

  • Added a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King, which can be obtained during the Clampdown side quest.

    [/*]

  • Added a new radio station, HKGN 102.0 FM, featuring a selection of tracks from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners series.

    [/*]

Show Off

  • A brand-new clothing collection has arrived in Night City! 5 new outfit sets can now be purchased from certain clothing vendors:

    • Maxiwear: available in Heywood, Arroyo, Little China

      [/*]

    • Jinguji: available in City Center

      [/*]

    • NetWatch: available in Kabuki, Japantown

      [/*]

    • IconAmerica: available in Pacifica, Badlands, Northside

      [/*]

    • And one more set that will hit Night City shelves just a little later...

      [/*]
    [/*]

    [/*]

    [/*]

  • Some of the hairstyles that were previously exclusive to NPCs are now available for V. Please note that some hairstyles are available only to feminine or masculine body types.

    [/*]

  • Show off your chrome! You can now customize your hand cyberware. Equip your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System, and visit one of 5 Glamdocs (marked with a spray paint icon on the map) to give your implants a fresh, new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.

    [/*]

  • Sometimes one gun just isn't enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category.

    [/*]

    [/*]

  • Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess.

    [/*]

Mod the World

Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. items.content:
To survive in Night City, you need someone to watch your back. On the way to the major leagues, V managed to gather a remarkable crew. You could even say, a crew to remember!

From trusted allies to unforgettable personalities, these are the people who helped shape V’s journey through the City of Dreams. This episode of It’s All About You is dedicated to the legendary crew that stood by V through every high and low.

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk 2077 in the most creative ways possible. Don’t forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY

See you in the next episode!

items.content:
Listen up, Samurai! 🤘🔥

Celebrate five years of Cyberpunk 2077 in this special anniversary episode of It’s All About You, looking back on Night City’s unforgettable stories through the legends and music you met along your journey!

Sure, the city’s full of noise — sirens, synths, gunfire in the distance — but if there’s one song that became its soul, it’s “Never Fade Away.”

We brought together legendary artists from across the city of dreams to reinterpret this iconic track — each in their own voice, their own style, their own rebellion. ❤️‍🔥

Plug in, turn it up, and dive into our latest It’s All About You episode.

Because legends don’t fade.
